outputs.prompt: Create panel 1 of a continuous 4:3 Flooded Works distant background: ancient flooded foundry-fortress ruins, broad clean flat-color planes, large silhouettes, charcoal/deep blue-green/muted verdigris/desaturated rust/tiny mustard palette, a simple low-frequency right overlap zone, no outline, playable terrain, hazards, characters, UI, text, noise, stippling, grain, dense patterns, or microtexture.

Using panel 1 as the visual reference, continue the same 4:3 Flooded Works background to the right. Match the previous right edge through the first 12 percent with the same wall/mist silhouettes, scale, waterline, palette, and lighting; keep the overlap landmark-free and retain the same flat, outline-free, low-detail constraints.

Create exactly five isolated orthographic Flooded Works terrain chunk directions on a removable flat magenta background: four solid masses with wide-low, medium-low, medium-mid, and medium-tall proportions plus one very wide thin catwalk; common flat palette/light direction, no outlines, labels, noise, tiny repeated details, or tile-grid seams.

Create poison-vent and crumbling-platform component families on a removable flat magenta background. Each family has one isolated canonical base and separate isolated state overlays; the overlays never duplicate or change the base body/pivot. Use the Flooded flat palette with no outlines, text, noise, tiny repeated details, or perspective drift.

outputs.postprocess: Normalize the generated 4x4 atlas to sixteen 64x64 cells, crop away separator pixels, and assemble a 256x256 atlas without changing tile order.
outputs.prompt: Create exactly sixteen orthographic top-down Flooded Works authoring tiles in a strict 4x4 atlas: four floor surfaces; shallow water, deep water, void, and pressure hazard; wall, low cover, narrow door, and wide gate footprints; player, enemy, prop, and objective markers. Use broad outline-free flat charcoal, blue-green, slate teal, and muted verdigris planes with only restrained semantic cyan, coral, and mustard accents. No text, labels, perspective, characters, noise, microtexture, or objects crossing cells.
